title: verbena gracilescens
intro: Verbena gracilescens, commonly known as the Dwarf Vervain or Brazilian Verbena, is a plant species belonging to the Verbenaceae family. It is a shrub-like herb with small white or purple flowers, native to the tropical regions of Brazil. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
